tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page ground: behind the battlefield and between HUD panels.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: HUD panels, intel cards, dialogue boxes.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: Menus and anything stacked on a panel (command menu, build list, tooltips).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside panels. Decorative only — never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control and panel edges; at least 3:1 on void, panel and panel-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on void, panel, panel-raised and signal-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, HUD labels and metadata on void, panel and panel-raised.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The interface accent: cursor, focus, selection, the active menu row, positive status. As text, on void, panel, panel-raised and signal-soft. Never a faction colour.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a signal fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for the selected row or active item, under ink or signal text.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Low fuel, low ammo, capture in progress. As text or icon on void, panel and panel-raised; always paired with a word or the warn diamond.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Critical HP, destroyed, mission-fail states. As text or icon on void, panel and panel-raised; always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: helion
tokens.usage: Helion Accord identity fill: unit plates, owned properties, banners.

tokens.name: on-helion
tokens.usage: Glyphs, sigils and text on a helion fill.

tokens.name: helion-ink
tokens.usage: Helion names and labels as text on void, panel and panel-raised.

tokens.name: tidewell
tokens.usage: Tidewell Union identity fill.

tokens.name: on-tidewell
tokens.usage: Glyphs, sigils and text on a tidewell fill.

tokens.name: tidewell-ink
tokens.usage: Tidewell names and labels as text on void, panel and panel-raised.

tokens.name: verdant
tokens.usage: Verdant Compact identity fill.

tokens.name: on-verdant
tokens.usage: Glyphs, sigils and text on a verdant fill.

tokens.name: verdant-ink
tokens.usage: Verdant names and labels as text on void, panel and panel-raised.

tokens.name: kestrel
tokens.usage: Kestrel Dominion identity fill.

tokens.name: on-kestrel
tokens.usage: Glyphs, sigils and text on a kestrel fill.

tokens.name: kestrel-ink
tokens.usage: Kestrel names and labels as text on void, panel and panel-raised.

tokens.name: choir
tokens.usage: Hollow Choir identity fill (obsidian). Always rimmed in on-choir so it reads on dark terrain.

tokens.name: on-choir
tokens.usage: The Choir’s red signal: glyphs, rims and sigils on a choir fill.

tokens.name: choir-ink
tokens.usage: Hollow Choir names and labels as text on void, panel and panel-raised.

tokens.name: map-ink
tokens.usage: HP digits and map labels, on map-shade only.

tokens.name: map-shade
tokens.usage: Unit outlines, the HP chip, tile grid lines on the battlefield.

tokens.name: overlay-move
tokens.usage: Movement-range wash over terrain (signal at 35%).

tokens.name: overlay-attack
tokens.usage: Attack-range wash over terrain (red at 40%). Paired with the crosshair cursor, never alone.

tokens.name: overlay-fog
tokens.usage: Fog of war and Ion Storm darkening over unseen tiles.

tokens.name: terrain-flats
tokens.usage: Flats: open ground.

tokens.name: terrain-flats-detail
tokens.usage: Grass ticks and field marks on flats.

tokens.name: terrain-canopy
tokens.usage: Canopy (engineered forest) ground.

tokens.name: terrain-canopy-detail
tokens.usage: Tree crowns on canopy.

tokens.name: terrain-ridge
tokens.usage: Ridge (mountain) rock.

tokens.name: terrain-ridge-detail
tokens.usage: Lit faces of ridge peaks.

tokens.name: terrain-sea
tokens.usage: Open sea.

tokens.name: terrain-sea-detail
tokens.usage: Wave marks; rivers and the water edge of shoals.

tokens.name: terrain-shoal
tokens.usage: Shoal (beach and reef shallows) sand.

tokens.name: terrain-maglev
tokens.usage: Maglev road and bridge deck.

tokens.name: terrain-maglev-detail
tokens.usage: The live rail line down a maglev.

tokens.name: terrain-glass
tokens.usage: Glass Waste: vitrified old-war desert.

tokens.name: terrain-glass-detail
tokens.usage: Fracture facets on glass waste.

tokens.name: terrain-structure
tokens.usage: Unowned (neutral) property body. Owned properties take their faction fill instead.

tokens.name: terrain-structure-detail
tokens.usage: Windows and seams on neutral properties.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Chakra Petch: angular, engineered. Titles, banners and every HUD label.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Act and mission titles, Overclock call-outs. One per screen.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Turn banner, results screens, panel titles in briefings.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and panel headings, speaker names in dialogue.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Commands, HUD labels, button text. Always set in capitals.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Barlow: a plain-spoken grotesque for anything read as sentences.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: They fired first at Calder. Nobody on our side gave that order.
styles.usage: Dialogue and briefings — the story voice.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Hover units cross shoals and rivers at no extra cost.
styles.usage: Descriptions, tooltips, rules text on cards.

groups.name: Numbers
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono: tabular figures so HP, funds and damage never jitter.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Funds, damage forecasts, the big number on a card.

spacing.note: 4px base; the battlefield runs on the tile, not on these.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-label gap, pip gaps in meters.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls and chips; between menu rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows on a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between panels; dialogue box padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Screen margins around the HUD.

radius.note: Chamfer, not curve: panels cut their corners (see chamfer); radii stay tiny.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: HP chip, meter pips, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Status chips and unit plates.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only round things: the Tidewell sigil, status dots.

size.note: The battlefield grid and the cut-corner geometry.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: One battlefield tile at 1×. Units, overlays and the cursor are sized from it.

tokens.name: tile-sm
tokens.usage: Tiles inside intel cards and the minimap.

tokens.name: portrait
tokens.usage: Commander portrait in dialogue and the CO select screen.

tokens.name: portrait-sm
tokens.usage: Commander portrait in the player HUD.

tokens.name: chamfer
tokens.usage: Corner cut on panels, dialogue boxes and banners (top-left and bottom-right).

tokens.name: chamfer-sm
tokens.usage: Corner cut on menus, cards and unit plates.

shadow.note: Edges do the work; shadows only lift floating things and mark focus.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogue boxes, anything floating over the battlefield.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px panel-colour gap, then 2px of solid signal. Applied as box-shadow so it follows the radius.

tokens.name: glow-select
tokens.usage: The selected unit and the battlefield cursor. Signal, same in both themes because it sits on terrain.
